definitions.gloss: looking forward to; eagerly awaited; long-awaited
definitions.explanation: Describes the feeling of eagerly wanting something to arrive or happen soon. Expresses anticipation and impatience for a positive event.

examples.japanese: {夏休|なつやす}みが{待|ま}ち{遠|どお}しい。
examples.english: I can't wait for summer vacation.

examples.japanese: {新作|しんさく}ゲームの{発売|はつばい}{日|び}が{待|ま}ち{遠|どお}しい。
examples.english: I'm eagerly awaiting the release date of the new game.

examples.japanese: {桜|さくら}の{季節|きせつ}が{待|ま}ち{遠|どお}しくて、{毎日|まいにち}{天気|てんき}{予報|よほう}をチェックしている。
examples.english: I'm so eager for cherry blossom season that I check the weather forecast every day.

notes:
Always used for positive anticipation — never for dreading something. The subject is the thing being awaited, marked by が.

PATTERN: Xが{待|ま}ち{遠|どお}しい (can't wait for X)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {春|はる}が{待|ま}ち{遠|どお}しい (looking forward to spring)
- {卒業|そつぎょう}が{待|ま}ち{遠|どお}しい (can't wait for graduation)
- {待|ま}ち{遠|どお}しくてたまらない (so eager one can barely stand it)

USAGE NOTE: This is a compound adjective from {待|ま}つ (to wait) + {遠|とお}い (far). Despite containing {遠|とお}い, the combined meaning is not about physical distance but emotional anticipation.
